name: clear-balance
description: Controle financeiro pessoal (MVP) — React + Node.js + PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev:lan -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
